subject: CLAIM Gen7 presentation-clock / timebase integrity review
body: CURRENT_MAIN_SHA=633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Claiming an orthogonal bounded lane: clock-domain provenance and normalization between trusted Samsung/public hinge sample times, callback/delivery times, and Choreographer FrameTimeline expected-presentation time, plus an independent challenge of Primary Gen7 Core V1 for mixed-clock hazards. Excludes predictor/control-law tuning, reacquisition math, refresh-lease policy, causal-diagnostic schema, renderer cutover, host migration/readiness, semantic authority, panel wake/routing, and production integration. Expected deliverable: source/platform-grounded clock contract, failure model, deterministic clock-offset/deep-sleep tests, and Manager handoff. No production Git writes.
